scholarships.name: Award-winning research
scholarships.description: Our research provides innovative solutions that benefit business, industry and communities in the UK and across the world and has won a series of awards. Funding is available for postgraduate research studies.

scholarships.name: Commuter Bursary
scholarships.description: Students from lower-income households can get up to 50% towards their monthly commuting costs, worth up to £1,000 per year.

scholarships.name: Greenwich progression bursary
scholarships.description: Power up your future and reach your potential through postgraduate study. Up to £3,000 bursary for eligible students and alumni.

scholarships.name: Accommodation Bursary
scholarships.description: We are committed to supporting students from a variety of backgrounds. This bursary offers up to £700 – a 10% discount on first-year accommodation fees.

scholarships.name: The Stephen Lawrence Scholarship
scholarships.description: Available to Black students for Architecture Part 2 MArch. Honouring Stephen Lawrence's legacy, this scholarship aims to increase Black representation in architecture, remove financial barriers to education, and fostering a more equitable industry. £19,070 scholarship available
